steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit from the sidebar.
How to read this page opens a short guide to every box and label on this screen.
Blank = unknown, 0 = none. A blank is listed as missing and never counted as zero.
Open the Zentrix negotiation — the landlord's first offer is already recorded.
Offer 1: present value of the whole term, rent total and the refundable deposit.
The landlord came back. Record Offer 2 — it starts pre-filled with Offer 1.
Change only what changed: rent ₹98 → ₹92, rent-free 2 → 4 months, deposit 10 → 6 months.
Save as Offer 2. Earlier offers stay exactly as recorded.
What changed: Offer 2 is ₹1.6 crore cheaper in present value — calculated, not AI.
Term by term: improved, unchanged or still unresolved with the landlord.
Concession packages: describe up to three asks (e.g. more rent-free) and see what each is worth.
Missing inputs: terms still unresolved with the landlord — listed, not assumed.
Risks: e.g. a long lock-in or a big deposit, flagged from the numbers.
Draft talking points can word your points for you (optional AI wording) — the numbers stay from the calculator.
Strategy reads the numbers and lists the open terms and risks. Nothing is sent from here.
Download deck makes an editable PowerPoint of these results for the client.
